Part B: ConservationAspect
- Created ConservationAspect.F90 following StateItemAspect pattern
- Separates 'what is conserved' (physics) from 'how to normalize' (mathematics)

  - QUANTITY_MIXING_RATIO → CONSERVE_MASS
  - QUANTITY_CONCENTRATION → CONSERVE_MASS
  - QUANTITY_PRESSURE → CONSERVE_MASS (relates to column mass)
  - QUANTITY_EXTENSIVE → CONSERVE_MASS
  - QUANTITY_TEMPERATURE/UNKNOWN → CONSERVE_NONE
- Connection matching: requires exact match of conservation_type
- Added to generic3g/specs/CMakeLists.txt

AspectId Updates:
- Added CONSERVATION_ASPECT_ID = 10
- Renumbered NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID to 11
- Renumbered INVERSE_NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID to 12

Magic Number Fix:
- Fixed NormalizationAspect lines 126, 150
- Replaced abs(scale_factor_diff) < 1e-10 with exact equality (==)

commit message:
Update Bracket aspect ordering to include new normalization aspects (issue #4482) (#4485)

* Update BracketClassAspect and VectorBracketClassAspect aspect ordering

Adds the three new aspects (QuantityType, Normalization, InverseNormalization)
to the aspect ordering in BracketClassAspect and VectorBracketClassAspect to
match FieldClassAspect and FieldBundleClassAspect.

These aspects were added in PR #4480 (Task 2.7) but Bracket classes were
inadvertently omitted. This ensures consistent aspect ordering across all
ClassAspect implementations for conservative regridding support.

Changes:
- BracketClassAspect::get_aspect_order() now returns complete aspect list
- VectorBracketClassAspect::get_aspect_order() now returns complete aspect list
- Removed time-dependent conditional logic (simplified to match Field/FieldBundle)

Fixes #4482

* Update Bracket aspect ordering for conservative regridding

Add QuantityTypeAspect and NormalizationAspect to BracketClassAspect
and VectorBracketClassAspect get_aspect_order() methods to align with
FieldClassAspect and FieldBundleClassAspect.

These aspects come before GEOM_ASPECT_ID in the ordering. The conditional
logic for time-dependent geometries is preserved, with CLASS/GEOM order
swapping based on whether time interpolation is needed.

Fixes #4482

commit message:
Integrate Extended Field Dictionary into MAPL3 (Phase 1 & 2, #4440) (#4577)

* Add extended FieldDictionary schema (Phase 1, #4440)

- Add VerificationStatus typed enum (unverified/verified/cf_compliant)
- Add ValidationMode typed enum (permissive/strict)
- Extend FieldDictionaryItem with conserved, verification_status,
  physical_dimension, and provenance fields; conserved=true drives
  CONSERVE regrid method by default
- Update FieldDictionary YAML parser to handle all new optional
  fields with backward-compatible defaults
- Add FieldDictionaryConfig for cap.yaml parsing and is_exempt()
  predicate for item types that skip dictionary validation
- Add field_dictionary_test.yaml with 20 fictitious test fields
  covering full v0.2.0 schema
- Extend Test_FieldDictionary.pf with tests for all new types
- Add GEOS_FieldDictionary v0.2.1 to components.yaml and .gitignore

* Integrate FieldDictionary into parse_var_specs (Phase 2, #4440)

- Add has_item() predicate to FieldDictionary to safely test key
  existence without crashing on NAG when key is absent (at() on
  missing key returns disassociated pointer under NAG).
- Add optional field_dict_config parameter to parse_var_specs;
  load FieldDictionary from configured path at call start.
- Apply dictionary defaults for units and long_name when
  standard_name is present and not overridden by YAML.
- Warn (permissive) or fail (strict) when standard_name has no
  dictionary entry; skip entirely for exempt item types (expression).
- Add optional long_name parameter to make_VariableSpec /
  VariableSpec so dictionary-derived long_name is stored.
- Make parse_var_specs public in ComponentSpecParser for testing.
- Add 8-test integration suite Test_FieldDictIntegration.pf covering
  dict defaults, YAML override, exempt types, permissive/strict modes,
  missing file, and multi-field cases. All 104 tests pass.

* Address PR #4577 review comments (#4440)

- FieldDictionaryConfig: restore default path to 'field_dictionary.yaml',
  remove warn_on_unverified/warn_on_non_cf booleans, add has_dictionary_path()
  predicate, use any() array syntax in is_exempt()
- FieldDictionaryItem: simplify constructor with set-default-then-override idiom
- parse_var_specs: build log_msg once for both _FAIL and lgr%warning;
  guard dict loading with has_dictionary_path(); keep dict_file_exists in
  outer scope for Fortran scoping compatibility
- VariableSpec: guard get_regrid_method_from_field_dict_ on has_dictionary_path()
  before inquire; use _ASSERT for missing file
- Test_FieldDictionary: update test_config_defaults for new defaults
- CMakeLists.txt: install geos_field_dictionary.yaml to etc/ when present

* Add field dictionary docs and fix CI-breaking _ASSERT (#4440)

- VariableSpec: replace _ASSERT on missing dictionary file with silent
  rc=_FAILURE so get_regrid_param falls back to default regrid method
  when field_dictionary.yaml is absent (all existing GEOS runs)
- docs/user_guide/docs/field_dictionary.md: new user guide covering
  configuration, schema, verification status, conserved flag, and
  experiment setup
- docs/mapl3/field_dictionary_developer.md: new developer reference
  covering module APIs, integration in parse_var_specs, design notes
- docs/user_guide/README.md: add section 3.11 linking to user guide

* Fix gfortran preprocessor error: no multi-line _ASSERT args (#4440)

gfortran's preprocessor does not handle macro arguments split across
continuation lines.  Replace multi-line _ASSERT calls in
FieldDictionary.F90 with a local msg variable built before the call.

* Fix gfortran associate+@assertEqual and unallocated long_name UB

Two CI-blocking fixes:

1. Test_FieldDictIntegration.pf: replace associate(vs => var_specs%of(i))
   + @assertEqual inside the block with a local VariableSpec variable
   assigned by copy.  gfortran's pFUnit preprocessor loses the type of
   the associate name inside @assertEqual, causing a compile error.

2. parse_var_specs.F90: guard make_VariableSpec call with
   if (allocated(long_name)) to avoid passing an unallocated
   character(:),allocatable as character(*),optional — undefined
   behaviour that caused status=506 failures in NAG application ctests.

* Revert long_name allocated() guard in parse_var_specs

Reverts the if/else duplication added in the previous commit.
The conditional is not the right fix; root cause needs investigation.

* WIP: add _HERE debug trace in run_DSOSetServices

* Remove debug _HERE trace from run_DSOSetServices

* Move field dictionary lookup into make_VariableSpec via module singleton

Architectural redesign: the field dictionary is now accessed through a
module-level singleton (load_field_dictionary / get_field_dictionary)
rather than being loaded and passed through parse_var_specs.

Changes:
- FieldDictionary.F90: add protected/private/target/save singleton
  'the_field_dictionary', load_field_dictionary(), get_field_dictionary()
- VariableSpec.F90: make_VariableSpec now calls get_field_dictionary()
  to fill units and long_name defaults from the singleton; remove
  FieldDictionaryConfig dependency; simplify get_regrid_method_from_field_dict_
  to use the singleton instead of loading its own copy
- parse_var_specs.F90: remove all field dictionary loading, lookup, and
  validation logic; drop field_dict_config argument
- ComponentSpecParser.F90: remove field_dict_config from parse_var_specs
  interface; drop use of mapl3g_FieldDictionaryConfig
- Test_FieldDictIntegration.pf: rewrite to test via make_VariableSpec
  and load_field_dictionary singleton; remove tests that were specific
  to the old parse_var_specs-based dict loading path

* Call load_field_dictionary from MaplFramework%initialize

Reads optional 'field_dictionary' key from mapl hconfig and loads the
singleton dictionary at startup, before any component SetServices runs.
If the key is absent, no dictionary is loaded and make_VariableSpec
silently skips the lookup.

* Simplify get_field_dictionary: always returns pointer to singleton

Remove dictionary_is_loaded flag and associated() checks. The singleton
is always a valid target; callers use has_item() to detect an empty
(unloaded) dictionary.

* Restore parse_var_specs.F90 to baseline (whitespace only diff)

* Fix NAG build errors and runtime crash

- FieldDictionary: move singleton declaration after type definition
  (NAG requires type to be defined before first use)
- FieldDictionary: remove unused error_unit import and n_erased
  variable; reuse status for alias_map%erase() return value
- FieldDictionary: guard add_aliases against empty StringVector to
  prevent disassociated pointer crash on default-constructed vector
- FieldDictionary: use initialize-then-overwrite pattern instead of
  if/else for optional YAML fields (cleaner, same semantics)
- FieldDictionaryItem: fix no-alias constructor to pass an explicit
  empty StringVector instead of zero-length character array literal
- VariableSpec: explicitly use mapl3g_FieldDictionaryItem so
  FieldDictionaryItem type is visible under implicit none(type,external)

* Make field dictionary mandatory at startup

- MaplFramework: always load the dictionary; default path is
  geos_field_dictionary.yaml in CWD if field_dictionary: key absent
- VariableSpec: assert standard_name is present in the dictionary
  (hard failure instead of silent skip)
- Skip dict lookup for compound vector names '(name1,name2)' since
  these are not dictionary keys but encode two component names
- Add required CF entries to field_dictionary_test.yaml for tests
  that pass standard_name for non-dict reasons (air_temperature,
  air_pressure PLE/PL, A)
- Load field_dictionary_test.yaml in @before of affected test suites
- configure_file() to copy field_dictionary_test.yaml to binary dir

* Soften field dictionary enforcement to warn+skip

GOCART and other external components may have standard_names not
yet in the dictionary, and CI environments may not have the dict
file at the default path. Hard failures would break those cases.

- MaplFramework: catch load failure and log a warning instead of
  propagating the error; the dictionary remains empty and lookups
  are silently skipped
- VariableSpec: replace _ASSERT on missing standard_name with a
  pflogger warning; units/long_name defaults are simply not applied

Hard enforcement can be added in a follow-on once all components
are updated to include entries in geos_field_dictionary.yaml.

* Update CMakeLists.txt

Agreed.

Co-authored-by: Matt Thompson <matthew.thompson@nasa.gov>

* Fix field dict init: use inquire() to avoid thrown exception

Catching a non-zero rc after calling load_field_dictionary() does
not suppress the pFUnit exception already thrown by MAPL_Verify
inside the call. Use Fortran inquire() to check file existence
before attempting to open, so ESMF_HConfigCreate is never called
on a missing file and no exception is thrown.

Behavior:
- Default path absent: warn + continue (no exception)
- Explicit path absent: hard fail via _ASSERT
- File present: load normally via _RC

* Fix CMakeLists install to support all mepo clone styles for GEOS_FieldDictionary

mepo can clone subrepos with no prefix, @ prefix, or @ suffix. Loop over
all three directory names so the install works regardless of clone style,
as suggested by mathomp4 in PR #4577 review.

* Update field dictionary docs to reflect current implementation

- Default filename is geos_field_dictionary.yaml (not field_dictionary.yaml)
- Missing default = warning + continue; only explicit path missing is fatal
- Rewrite developer doc integration section: lookup is in make_VariableSpec,
  not parse_var_specs; add MaplFramework initialization description with
  explanation of why inquire() is used before load_field_dictionary

* Address darianboggs PR review comments

- Fix inconsistent indentation in FieldDictionary.F90 (type body and get_item)
- Fix extra-space indentation on parse_var_specs in ComponentSpecParser.F90
- Use to_lower() in ValidationMode and VerificationStatus string constructors
  for truly case-insensitive parsing (not just lower/UPPER)
- Add missing @assertTrue(UNVERIFIED /= CF_COMPLIANT) in operator tests
  (/= is not transitive so all three pairs must be checked)

* Fix NAG/ifx CI failure: remove @before from ESMF_TestMethod test module

@before in a module with @test(type=ESMF_TestMethod) causes pFUnit to
generate code that passes the before-routine via ESMF_TestMethod's private
TREE component, which NAG and ifx both reject.

Move load_field_dictionary call into setup() instead, which is called by
every ESMF_TestMethod test. This matches the pattern used in
Test_VectorBasisKind.pf.

Add Task 7 integration test scenarios for vertical alignment

This commit adds three integration test scenarios for vertical alignment support:

1. vertical_alignment_same_grid: Tests degenerate case where same vertical
   grid has fields with different alignments (downward vs upward). Verifies
   copy-with-flip functionality.

2. vertical_alignment_regrid: Tests full vertical regridding with different

   regridding with appropriate flips.

3. vertical_alignment_with_grid: Tests default 'with_grid' alignment where
   fields automatically use their grid's coordinate_direction. Both grids
   use downward direction.

These scenarios exercise the vertical alignment implementation from Tasks 1-6
and verify proper handling of coordinate_direction and vertical_alignment.

commit message:
Fixes #141. Reduce compiler warning messages

Most of these fixes are adding `_UNUSED_DUMMY()` lines or just plain deleting variables that were never used.

The one exciting one was in MAPL_TripolarGridFactory where `name` was never set so Intel throws:

```
/discover/swdev/mathomp4/Models/MAPL-MAPL20-Cleanup/MAPL/MAPL_Base/MAPL_TripolarGridFactory.F90(507): warning #6178: The return value of this FUNCTION has not been defined.   [NAME]
   function generate_grid_name(this) result(name)
--------------------------------------------^
```

So we set name to a blank string and then the `error stop` will take care of everything still.

Finally, update to ESMA_cmake v2.1.2 to suppress long names warnings:
```
/discover/swdev/mathomp4/Models/GEOSgcm-MAPL20-MAPLCleanup/GEOSgcm/src/Shared/@MAPL/MAPL_Base/MAPL_TilingRegridder.F90: warning #5462: Global name too long, shortened from: mapl_tilingregriddermod_mp_copy_global_to_local_$blk.pfio_errorhandlingmod_mp_mpi_statuses_ignore_ to: pl_tilingregriddermod_mp_copy_global_to_local_$blk.pfio_errorhandlingmod_mp_mpi_statuses_ignore_
^
```

This adds a new `DISABLE_GLOBAL_NAME_WARNING` flag to suppress this output

commit message:
Add Test 5a: Combined horizontal+vertical conservative regridding

This test validates the complete 3D conservative regridding workflow:
- 4×4 → 6×6 horizontal grid (conservative ESMF regridding)
- 10 → 15 vertical layers (conservative vertical regridding)
- Tests realistic GEOS use case where tracers must be regridded both
  horizontally and vertically between model components

Key implementation details:
- Uses GeomManager to create grids with proper cell corners for
  conservative regridding (instead of manual ESMF_GridAddCoord)
- Uses ESMF_NamedAlias to provide 'import[1]' and 'export[1]' names
  required by RegridTransform and VerticalRegridTransform
- Horizontal regrid operates on extensive quantity (q×Δp)
- Converts back to mixing ratio (q) before vertical regrid
- Vertical regridder handles Δp weighting internally
- Verifies mass conservation: sum(q × Δp × area)

Test passes with relative error < 5.3e-8 (well below 1e-5 tolerance).

Fixes #4497

commit message:
Phase 0: Rename get_num_levels→get_num_layers to fix semantic ambiguity

This commit renames VerticalGrid::get_num_levels() to get_num_layers()
and updates VerticalStaggerLoc::get_num_levels() parameter semantics
to fix a critical semantic bug in the VerticalGrid architecture.

The Problem:
- VerticalGrid::get_num_levels() returned num_layers (CENTER levels)
- VerticalStaggerLoc::get_num_levels(num_vgrid_levels) assumed input
  was num_edges and computed CENTER as num_edges - 1
- This caused FixedLevelsVerticalGrid(3 layers) at CENTER to create
  2 levels instead of 3 (incorrect: 3-1=2 instead of correct: 3)

The Solution:
- Renamed VerticalGrid::get_num_levels() → get_num_layers()
- Updated VerticalStaggerLoc::get_num_levels(num_layers) semantics:
  * EDGE: num_layers + 1 (was: num_edges)
  * CENTER: num_layers (was: num_edges - 1)
  * NONE: 0 (unchanged)
  * MIRROR: num_layers + 1 (was: num_edges)

Changes:
- VerticalGrid base class and all implementations (Basic, Fixed, Model, Mirror)
- VerticalStaggerLoc.F90 - parameter rename and logic fix
- All production code callers (FieldInfo, FieldCreate, MAPL_Generic, VerticalGridAspect)
- All test files updated with new semantics

Tests:
- ✅ Build succeeds (NAG compiler)
- ✅ MAPL.vertical_grid.tests pass (100%)
- ✅ MAPL.generic3g.tests pass (100%)
- ⚠️  4 field tests need updates (expected - will fix in continuation)

Refs: #4487

commit message:
Baby steps towards oomph.
  - Partial refactoring of old VarConnPoint.
  - Introduced gFTL VarConnVector
  - Split types into separate files.
    It can be hard to find the definitions of types when they are not
    tied to an obvious module/file.  This is particularly true in
    light of some recent refactorings that left chaos in their wake.
    Current MAPL style guidelines points to a natural solution.
  - Introduced fine-grained specs.

    . Legacy VarSpecType has a long laundry list of components.  Some
      rarely used; some never used. And worse, some that no one even
      recalls what they are for.

    . New specs are more targeted and hierarchical.  E.g., DimsSpec
      has spec components for horizontal, vertical, and ungridded
      dimensions.

    . Mostl likely these new specs will be just "structs" with no
      methods.  But at least one component (possibly otherwise unused)
      should remain private to prevent use of default constructors.

    . Legacy VarSpecType now has a FieldSpec component that is
      initialized during the VarSpecType component.

commit message:
Demonstrated ExtData scenario

The `post_advertise` phase is used to do "late" connections.  This is
demonstrated with precision extensions in a prototype of a real
extdata component.   The real scenario would involve the Collection
component exporting IntervalSpecs that are connected to ExtData
_after_ the usual connections are complete.

As part of this exercise, "mirroring" was introduced in FieldSpec, but
only for Precision matching for now.

A small fix was introduced into handling of wildcard
patterns. Previously MatchALl was too aggressive for matching source
specs because "^" and "$" were not used to force the pattern to span
the entire string rather than match strings that had matching
substrings. E.g.,  a dst pattern of "E1" should not match a src
virtual pt named "connection/E1".

commit message:
Task 2.6b: Conservative Vertical Regridding Matrix Construction (#4465)

* Implement conservative vertical regridding matrix construction

Add compute_conservative_map() function for mass-conserving vertical
regridding using overlap-based weight computation.

Algorithm:
- For each destination layer, find all overlapping source layers
- Weight each source contribution by overlap fraction
- Store in sparse CSR matrix format
- Conserves mass: sum of weights per row = 1.0

Implementation:
- Handles both increasing and decreasing coordinates (height/pressure)
- Uses layer interfaces (edges), not centers
- Robust overlap computation with epsilon tolerance
- Comprehensive documentation

Tests (6 new tests):
- test_conservative_map_identity: Same grid → identity matrix
- test_conservative_map_coarse_to_fine: 2→4 layers
- test_conservative_map_fine_to_coarse: 4→2 layers
- test_conservative_map_decreasing_coords: Pressure-like coords
- test_conservative_map_partial_overlap: Non-aligned grids
- All tests verify exact expected values

Next: Integrate into VerticalRegridTransform to select method
based on VerticalRegridMethod parameter.

* Integrate conservative regridding into VerticalRegridTransform

- Add compute_conservative_map to imports from VerticalLinearMap
- Update initialize() to accept both LINEAR and CONSERVATIVE methods
- Pass method parameter to compute_interpolation_matrix_()
- Add conditional dispatch to select compute_linear_map() or compute_conservative_map()
- Maintains backward compatibility with LINEAR method
- CONSERVATIVE method now available for use in vertical regridding

Relates to #4461

* Add integration test for conservative vertical regridding

- Test verifies VERTICAL_REGRID_CONSERVATIVE method can be initialized
- Uses edge-staggered coordinates (required for conservative method)
- Tests basic conservation property: uniform input -> uniform output
- Coarse-to-fine regridding (4 layers -> 2 layers)

Relates to #4461

* Refactor: separate conservative map from linear map

Move conservative regridding to dedicated module for better separation
of concerns. Linear interpolation and conservative regridding are
fundamentally different algorithms and should be in separate files.

Changes:
- Create VerticalConservativeMap.F90 (sibling to VerticalLinearMap.F90)
- Move compute_conservative_map() from VerticalLinearMap to new module
- Create Test_VerticalConservativeMap.pf with all conservative tests
- Remove conservative tests from Test_VerticalLinearMap.pf
- Update imports in VerticalRegridTransform.F90
- Update CMakeLists.txt for both source and tests

Benefits:
- Clearer naming: 'Linear' module is only for linear interpolation
- Better separation of concerns
- Easier to maintain and extend each method independently
- More intuitive file organization

Relates to #4461

* Fix pfunit assertion syntax in conservative integration test

- Replace @assertEqual with @assert_that for enum comparison
- Replace @assertEqual with @assert_that(..., is(near(...))) for float comparison
- Use proper pfunit matcher syntax for better test clarity

* Fix conservative map to use full row representation

The CSR sparse matrix format used by add_row() expects consecutive
columns in each row. The previous implementation incorrectly assumed
it could pass non-consecutive column indices.

Fix: Store full row with zeros for non-overlapping source layers,
then pass all nlev_src values starting from column 1.

Changes:
- Initialize row_weights to all zeros for each destination layer
- Store weight at row_weights(k) for overlapping source layer k
- Call add_row with full row: add_row(matrix, j, 1, row_weights(1:nlev_src))
- Adjust matrix nnz allocation to nlev_dst * nlev_src (full storage)
- Remove unused num_overlaps and row_indices variables

This ensures matmul correctly applies weights from the right source layers.

Fixes test failures where actual values were multiples of expected.

* Fix conservative vertical regridding to use intensive conservation

- Changed weight formula from overlap/source_thickness to overlap/dest_thickness
- This ensures row sums = 1.0, preserving averages (intensive quantities)
- Fixed overlap detection to properly handle non-overlapping layers
- Updated unit tests to expect intensive conservation behavior
- All 6 conservative regridding tests now pass (5 unit + 1 integration)

commit message:
Phase 2 Task 2.2: Implement NormalizationTransform

This commit implements Phase 2, Task 2.2 of the conservative regridding implementation:
creating NormalizationTransform to perform the actual normalization operations on field data.

The NormalizationTransform multiplies fields by auxiliary fields (DELP or DZ) with scale
factors (e.g., 1/g for DELP-based normalization). This transform will be used by
NormalizationAspect during 3D conservative regridding operations.

New files:
- generic3g/transforms/NormalizationTransform.F90: Transform implementation (175 lines)
  - Extends ExtensionTransform following the established pattern
  - Supports both R4 and R8 precision
  - Handles both individual fields and field bundles
  - Multiplies field data by (aux_field × scale_factor)

- generic3g/tests/Test_NormalizationTransform.pf: Comprehensive test suite (416 lines)
  - test_normalize_field_R4: Tests R4 field normalization
  - test_normalize_field_R8: Tests R8 field normalization
  - test_normalize_bundle_R4: Tests bundle normalization
  - test_zero_normalization: Tests edge case with zero input

Modified files:
- generic3g/transforms/TransformId.F90: Added NORMALIZATION_TRANSFORM_ID = 9
- generic3g/transforms/CMakeLists.txt: Added NormalizationTransform.F90 to build
- generic3g/tests/CMakeLists.txt: Added Test_NormalizationTransform.pf to test suite

Implementation follows ConvertUnitsTransform pattern. All tests pass with NAG compiler.
Ready for integration with NormalizationAspect in Task 2.3.

commit message:
Adopt ESMF_StateItemFlag

Previously, MAPL was defining its own derived type for this purpose.
The rationale was that MAPL has additional caes.  Now MAPL uses the
ESMF type, but defines its own parameters with the `MAPL` namespace
instead of `ESMF` namespace.

Where MAPL and ESMF overlap, we define our parameters in terms of
theirs.   E.g., `MAPL_STATEITEM_FIELD = ESMF_STATEITEM_FIELD`.

commit message:
Generalized propagation of geomtry

- Components can now receieve their geometry from their parent or a
  designated child provider.  The can also provide their own.

  To achieve this the INIT_GEOM phase is now split into two:
    - GENERIC::INIT_ADVERTISE_GEOM
    - GENERIC::INIT_REALIZE_GEOM

- The ComponentSpecParser now holds an object of the new type
  GeometrySpec. In turn, GeometrySpec holds an optional GeomSpec.
  Previously, ComponentSpecParser stored the HConfig that would later
  establish GeomSpec, but this is now processed immediately for
  consistency.

- A test scenario, `propagete_geom` has been added to verify at least
  some of this functionality.
  Added test for complex geometry propagation.

  - child A provides geom.
  - root parent gets geom from child A
  - child B gets geom from parent

  For test to succeed both children must acquire a geom before
  advertising their fields.

author: Tom Clune <thomas.l.clune@nasa.gov>
commit message:
Feature/#4386 vectorbracket basis kind (#4387)

* Add vector basis kind support for regridding

This implements issue #4376 by introducing VectorBasisKind to distinguish
between NS (North-South/geographic) and GRID (grid-relative) vector
components during regridding operations.

Key changes:
- New VectorBasisKind enum (NS, GRID, INVALID) in esmf_utils
- String-based VariableSpec API: vector_basis_kind='NS' or 'GRID'
- Field bundle metadata storage via FieldBundleSet/Get
- Regridder integration: passes basis kind directly to get_basis()
- Validation ensures vector_basis_kind only used with VECTOR bundles
- get_basis() refactored with early returns (no nesting)
- Comprehensive test suite (12 tests covering all scenarios)

User API supports vector_basis_kind='NS' (default for vectors) or 'GRID'.
The enum-based internal API ensures type safety throughout the stack.

* Fix unallocated vector_basis_kind bugs

- VariableSpec: Check allocation before accessing vector_basis_kind
- VariableSpec: Default to VECTOR_BASIS_KIND_NS when unallocated
- FieldBundleCreate: Auto-set NS basis for VECTOR bundles
- Remove unused status variable in verify_deferred_items

* Use itemType to detect vectors in VariableSpec

Addresses reviewer feedback to use the canonical itemType field
instead of heuristics (vector_component_names, standard_name format)
to determine if a VariableSpec represents a vector.

Changes:
- VariableSpec: Check itemType == MAPL_STATEITEM_VECTOR
- Removed complex heuristic logic and unused is_vector variable
- Test_VectorBasisKind: Added itemtype parameter and import

* Add vector_basis_kind for VectorBracket

- Add vector_basis_kind support to VectorBracketClassAspect
- Generalize VectorBracket regridding for any even number of fields
- Simplify vector_basis_kind validation in VariableSpec
- Make vector_basis_kind non-allocatable (always has default value)

* Fix constant name: VECTORBRACKET not VECTOR_BRACKET

Rename MAPL_STATEITEM_VECTOR_BRACKET to MAPL_STATEITEM_VECTORBRACKET
for consistency with naming convention MAPL_STATEITEM_<class> where
the class is VectorBracket (no underscore in compound name).

commit message:
Remove MAPL_SUPPORT_MAPL3 build option

Removes the MAPL_SUPPORT_MAPL3 CMake option and all associated
MAPL_TARGET_PREFIX variable logic (GH-4633).

The dual-mount MAPL2+MAPL3 approach has been abandoned due to
vtable mismatches and symbol ambiguity from 23+ shared source
files with identical Fortran module names and C symbols. The
strategy is superseded by a single-mount MAPL3-only approach.

Changes:
- Remove option() declaration and if/else blocks in top-level
  CMakeLists.txt; all previously gated subdirectories (Apps,
  generic, gridcomps, docs, benchmarks, Python, Tests) are now
  unconditionally added
- Replace ${MAPL_TARGET_PREFIX} with literal 'MAPL' across all
  component CMakeLists.txt files
- Remove MAPL_SUPPORT_MAPL3 guards from MAPL/CMakeLists.txt and
  base/tests/CMakeLists.txt
- Remove #ifdef MAPL_SUPPORT_MAPL3 preprocessor guards from
  MAPL/MAPL.F90; module is now unconditionally 'module MAPL'
- Update CHANGELOG.md

commit message:
Fixes #4338 Feature/#4338 reduce warnings (#4342)

* Fix unassigned function results in Transform classes

- Explicitly initialize TimeInterpolateTransform, ExtendTransform, and NullTransform constructors
- Add explanatory comments about why explicit assignment is needed for NAG
- These functions return derived types that are default-initialized, but NAG requires explicit assignment
- Eliminates 3 NAG compiler warnings about unassigned function results

The two remaining warnings in ModelVerticalGrid and FixedLevelsVerticalGrid for create_spec_from_file_metadata are intentional - these are placeholder implementations that return _FAILURE with an unallocated result, which is the correct behavior for unimplemented functionality.

* Fix unassigned function results in generic3g

- Remove unnecessary constructor functions from Transform classes
  (TimeInterpolateTransform, ExtendTransform, NullTransform)
  These types can use Fortran's default structure constructors
- Fix allocatable function results in VerticalGrid factory methods
  (ModelVerticalGrid, FixedLevelsVerticalGrid) to use explicit
  structure constructors with appropriate arguments
- Eliminates all 'Result has not been assigned a value' NAG warnings
  in generic3g subdirectory

* Remove unused local variables in generic3g

Eliminates all 'Unused local variable' NAG warnings:
- Remove unused bundle_info from TimeInterpolateTransform procedures
  (run_r4, run_r8, run_r4_vector, run_r8_vector)
- Remove unused status from BracketClassAspect and
  VectorBracketClassAspect conversion functions

Simplifies procedures and makes code easier to understand.

* Fix compilation error: restore status variables needed by _RC macros

The previous commit incorrectly removed status variables from
to_BracketClassAspect_from_map and to_VectorBracketClassAspect_from_map
which are required by the _RC macro expansion.

* Remove redundant phase lookup in finalize

The finalize subroutine was computing phase_idx from phase_name
and then passing phase_name to run_custom, which internally
recomputes phase_idx from phase_name. This was redundant work.

Removed the duplicate phase lookup code and unused variables
(phase_idx, finalize_phases, found) from finalize.

Eliminates 'Questionable: Variable PHASE_IDX set but never referenced' warning.

- Remove unused import: MAPL_Am_I_Root

commit message:
Add day-of-week scale factor handling to ExtData

This update was originally put into the geoschem/gchp repository by
S. Eastham in commit 1e459ba5. To use, put D in the climatology column
of ExtData.rc.

Files used with this option should have 7 or 84 entries for the time
dimension (7 days per week * 1 or 12 months). Time index in the file
is used to determine what scale factors to retrieve. The first 7 indexes
correspond to scale factors for January with the following index to
day mapping: 1=Sunday, 2=Monday, 3=Tuesday, 4=Wednesday, 5=Thursday,
6=Friday, 7=Saturday. The next 7 indexes correspond to February day-of-week
scale factors, and so on. If there are only 7 values in the file then
those day-of-week factors apply to all months.

commit message:
Update MAPL_LatLonGridFactory.F90

Some reprocessed GEOS-Chem input data specifies the first and last latitudes for pole-centered data as instead being at (90 - dlat/2) N/S. This results in MAPL treating the data as being regional, which in turns results in incorrect bilinear interpolation of (eg) wind data at the poles - giving non-physical results. This fix checks specifically for this incorrect latitude specification, correcting it to a conventional "pole-centered" specification if detected.

commit message:
Fix: Set mirror=false for default normalization aspects

The new aspects (QuantityType, Normalization, InverseNormalization) should
be Category 1 aspects with sensible defaults, not mirror mode:

- QuantityTypeAspect: QUANTITY_UNKNOWN (generic handling, no special processing)
- NormalizationAspect: No normalization parameters (no transform needed)
- InverseNormalizationAspect: No denormalization (no transform needed)

Setting mirror=false ensures both sides of a connection have explicit
default values, avoiding the double-mirror error (case 2 in can_connect_to).
When both have default values, matches() returns true and no transform is created.

If conservative regridding is later requested with QUANTITY_UNKNOWN, we can
error at that point. Eventually FieldDictionary will provide proper defaults.

commit message:
Fix parallel build race condition in generic3g tests

Create a shared library MAPL.generic3g.test_common for common test
sources (MockUserGridComp.F90, accumulator_transform_test_common.F90,
MockAspect.F90) to prevent parallel build conflicts when multiple test
suites compile the same files to the same MODULE_DIRECTORY.

This resolves the race condition that caused build failures in
parallel builds, especially with gfortran-15 and Ninja builds, where
module files would conflict:
  'Cannot rename module file mockaspect_mod.smod0 to mockaspect_mod.smod'

The shared library approach ensures these common sources are compiled
once and linked by all test suites, eliminating file conflicts during
parallel builds.

commit message:
Task 4: Enhance VerticalRegridTransform for consistency with integrated normalization (#4539)

* Enhance GeomAspect to support integrated normalization

Implements Task 3 of the MAPL3 Integrated Normalization Plan (issue #4529).

Key changes:
- Refactored GeomAspect::make_transform using Fortran submodule pattern
  to resolve circular dependency with VerticalGridAspect
- Enhanced make_transform to detect normalization requirements for
  conservative regridding
- Query NormalizationAspect and VerticalGridAspect from aspect map
- Obtain vertical coordinate fields via coupler pattern
- Pass normalization metadata and coordinate info to RegridTransform
- Added get_physical_dimension() method to NormalizationType for
  mapping normalization type to physical dimension name

Implementation notes:
- Uses submodule in generic3g/specs/GeomAspect/make_transform.F90 to
  break circular module dependency
- Extracts helper functions (should_use_normalization,
  build_normalized_regrid_transform) to reduce complexity
- Proper error handling: checks status before using boolean results
- Falls back to standard regridding for non-conservative methods

Resolves #4529

* Refactor VerticalGridAspect to query NormalizationAspect

Replace QuantityTypeAspect with NormalizationAspect for determining
vertical regridding normalization requirements. This aligns the vertical
transform with the horizontal transform's integrated normalization pattern.

Changes:
- Replace QuantityTypeAspect import with NormalizationAspect and NormalizationType
- Query NormalizationAspect to get normalization type
- Check if normalization type is not NORMALIZE_NONE
- Maintain backward compatibility by defaulting to no normalization if aspect absent

The VerticalRegridTransform implementation already uses the fused normalization
pattern (denormalize -> regrid -> renormalize) and computes dp from PLE coordinate
fields correctly, so no changes needed there.

Related to issue #4530 (Task 4 of MAPL3 Integrated Normalization Plan)

* Export get_regridder_param for submodule access

The make_transform submodule needs to call get_regridder_param, but it
was not accessible because it was private to the module. This caused
linker errors with gfortran (and likely other compilers) during clean
builds, though incremental NAG builds masked the issue.

Fix: Add get_regridder_param to the public exports list.

This fixes the build failure in PR #4538.

* Address PR #4538 review comments

- Use esma_add_fortran_submodules for GeomAspect submodule
- Add 'only' clauses to normalization imports in GeomAspect.F90
- Import NORMALIZE_NONE and operator(==) in submodule

Addresses inline comments from @pchakraborty on PR #4538

commit message:
Optimize mesh creation from files with automatic and custom distribution paths

This commit refactors MeshGeomFactory to use ESMF_MeshCreate directly when
reading mesh files, providing significant performance improvements through
ESMF's native parallel I/O while maintaining support for custom decompositions.

Changes:
- Add is_uniform_decomposition() to detect default even element distributions
- Add decomp_to_distgrid() to convert custom MeshDecomposition to ESMF_DistGrid
- Modify create_esmf_mesh() with two optimized paths:
  * Path 1: Automatic distribution for uniform decompositions (most common case)
  * Path 2: Custom distribution via elementDistgrid for non-uniform cases
- Remove manual file reading when using ESMF's built-in reader
- Maintain backward compatibility with programmatically-created meshes

Benefits:
- Simplified code: removes ~50 lines of manual file reading for uniform cases
- Better performance: leverages ESMF's optimized parallel I/O
- Flexibility: supports both automatic and custom distributions transparently
- No API changes: decision made automatically based on decomposition type

Tests:
- Add comprehensive test suite (Test_MeshGeomFactory_Distribution.pf) with 5 tests
- All tests pass: automatic distribution, custom distribution, remainder handling,
  single-PE case, and backward compatibility
- No existing tests broken

commit message:
Add TimeMin and TimeMax statistical extensions to StatisticsGridComp

This commit adds two new time-based statistical modules:

- TimeMin: Computes minimum values over a specified time period
- TimeMax: Computes maximum values over a specified time period

Both modules:
- Extend AbstractTimeStatistic for polymorphic integration
- Support R4 (32-bit) and R8 (64-bit) floating point types
- Handle MAPL_UNDEF values correctly by skipping undefined data
- Integrate with ESMF alarm-based triggering for period termination
- Use efficient single-pass computation (vs two-phase accumulation)
- Export results to ESMF state for output

Implementation highlights:
- Elegant nested where clauses for min/max logic
- First-sample initialization with MAPL_UNDEF
- Running min/max update on subsequent samples
- Proper error handling with MAPL macros
- No compilation warnings or errors

The modules follow MAPL conventions and are ready for integration
into StatisticsGridComp and deployment to production systems.

commit message:
Task 2.4: Add inverse normalization support to NormalizationTransform (#4458)

* Add InverseNormalizationAspect for Task 2.3

Implements InverseNormalizationAspect which reverses normalization
performed by NormalizationAspect. This aspect divides fields by an
auxiliary field (e.g., delp or dz) to convert from extensive per-area
units back to intensive units after regridding.

Key features:
- Mirrors NormalizationAspect API and behavior but performs inverse operation
- Supports division by auxiliary fields (delp, dz) with scale factors
- Includes comprehensive unit tests (14 tests, all passing)
- Registered as INVERSE_NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID (11) in AspectId.F90

This aspect will be used in Phase 2 of conservative regridding to
denormalize fields after vertical regridding is complete.

Fixes #4455

* Refactor: Use single NormalizationAspect class with is_inverse flag

- Eliminate InverseNormalizationAspect.F90 (~458 lines of duplicate code)
- Add is_inverse boolean flag to NormalizationAspect
- Update get_aspect_id() to return correct ID based on is_inverse flag
- Add get_is_inverse() and set_is_inverse() methods
- Add compute_denormalized_units() helper for inverse mode
- Update update_from_payload() to handle both modes
- Update Test_InverseNormalizationAspect.pf to use single class
- Remove InverseNormalizationAspect from CMakeLists.txt

Benefits:
- Eliminates ~458 lines of duplicated code
- Easier to maintain - changes in one place
- Clear separation: aspect ID for type system, boolean for behavior

Issue #4455

* Fix: Store aspect_id as member variable to comply with nopass requirement

- Add aspect_id_value member variable to NormalizationAspect
- Set aspect_id_value in constructor based on is_inverse flag
- Keep get_aspect_id() as nopass (returns default NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID)
- Add get_instance_aspect_id() method to get actual instance's aspect_id
- Update test to use get_instance_aspect_id()

Fixes CI error: 'If either an overriding binding or an overridden binding
has a passed-object dummy argument, then the other must also'

* Refactor: InverseNormalizationAspect extends NormalizationAspect

Architecture:
- NormalizationAspect: base class with all implementation
- InverseNormalizationAspect: thin subclass (~50 lines) that:
  - Extends NormalizationAspect
  - Overrides get_aspect_id() to return INVERSE_NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID
  - Sets is_inverse=.true. in constructor
  - Inherits all other functionality

Benefits:
- Two distinct aspect IDs (enables both in same connection)
- Minimal code duplication (~50 lines vs ~458 in original approach)
- All implementation in one place (maintainability)
- Single Transform class will take boolean for direction (Task 2.4)

Issue #4455

* Fix: Remove invalid 'protected' attribute from type component

The 'protected' attribute is only valid for module-level variables,
not for type components. This was causing a compilation error in CI.

Fixes compilation error: 'This attribute specification is not valid
for a component definition statement. [PROTECTED]'

* Remove private from NormalizationAspect components for subclass access

InverseNormalizationAspect extends NormalizationAspect and needs to
access the is_inverse component. Removing the private statement from
the type definition allows the subclass to access parent components.

This follows the same pattern used in NormalizationTransform.

* Keep components private, pass is_inverse via constructor

Instead of removing private from NormalizationAspect components,
add an optional is_inverse parameter to the constructor. This:

1. Restores private attribute on NormalizationAspect type components
2. Adds optional is_inverse parameter to new_NormalizationAspect()
3. Updates InverseNormalizationAspect to pass is_inverse=.true.
   to parent constructor instead of directly accessing the component

This maintains proper encapsulation while allowing the subclass
to configure the parent's behavior through the constructor.

* Add inverse normalization support to NormalizationTransform (Task 2.4)

Extends NormalizationTransform with optional is_inverse parameter to support
both forward normalization (multiply) and inverse normalization (divide).

Changes:
- Add is_inverse boolean member to NormalizationTransform (default false)
- Update constructor to accept optional is_inverse parameter
- Modify update_field() to divide when is_inverse=true (with zero protection)
- Pass is_inverse through update_field_bundle()
- Support both R4 and R8 typekinds
- Add public export of new_NormalizationTransform function
- Remove private attribute from type components (NAG compiler requirement)

Tests:
- test_denormalize_field_R4: Verify inverse with R4 typekind
- test_denormalize_field_R8: Verify inverse with R8 typekind
- test_division_by_zero_R4: Safe handling of zero denominator
- test_roundtrip_R4: Verify normalize→denormalize recovers original

Division by zero handling: When denominator < epsilon, output = 0.0

Note: Aspects still return NullTransform() - coupler infrastructure
needed to create actual transforms (deferred to future tasks).

Issue: #4457

* Fix test_roundtrip_R4: Add COUPLER_IMPORT_NAME to midState

The midState needs both COUPLER_EXPORT_NAME and COUPLER_IMPORT_NAME
because it serves as:
- Export state for the normalize transform
- Import state for the denormalize transform

Without COUPLER_IMPORT_NAME, the denormalize step fails with
'Mismatched item types' when it can't find the expected field name.

* Fix ESMF_StateAdd syntax: remove array syntax when using itemName

ESMF_StateAdd with itemName parameter doesn't support array syntax.
Use scalar field argument instead of [field_mid] when adding with
custom itemName.

* Fix test_roundtrip_R4: Use separate states for chaining transforms

The rigid COUPLER_IMPORT_NAME/COUPLER_EXPORT_NAME convention prevents
directly chaining transforms through a single intermediate state.

Solution:
- Create separate export and import states for the intermediate value
- Manually copy data between them (simulates what a coupler would do)
- This reveals the architectural constraint that will be resolved
  when coupler support is added (similar to VerticalRegridTransform)

In production, couplers will handle data movement between transforms.
This test demonstrates the need for that infrastructure.

commit message:
Refactor get_coordinate_field interface to use AspectMap (#4484)

This commit addresses issue #4481 by refactoring the get_coordinate_field()
interface to accept an AspectMap instead of individual scalar parameters
(geom, units, typekind). This makes the interface robust to future changes
when new StateItemAspect subclasses are added.

Key changes:
- Abstract interface now accepts aspects parameter as class(*) to avoid
  circular module dependencies between vertical_grid/ and generic3g/
- Implementations use select type to convert class(*) to AspectMap
- Callee now adds VerticalGridAspect internally to avoid Fortran aliasing
  issues (VerticalGridAspect contains pointer to 'this')
- physical_dimension remains a separate parameter as it's derived information
  computed from comparing source/destination vertical grids
- Call site in VerticalGridAspect::make_transform() updated to build and
  pass AspectMap containing GEOM, TYPEKIND, UNITS, UNGRIDDED_DIMS,
  ATTRIBUTES, and CLASS aspects
- Tests updated to reflect new interface

This eliminates the fragile unpack/repack pattern where callers extracted
individual aspects from an AspectMap, passed them as scalars, and then the
callee had to repack them back into aspects.

commit message:
Fix NormalizationAspect serialization to preserve QuantityTypeAspect metadata

This commit fixes two issues related to the new aspect ordering:

1. NormalizationAspect.update_payload() now correctly handles the interaction
   with QuantityTypeAspect by reading existing metadata before deciding whether
   to write. This preserves the normalization metadata derived from quantity
   types when NormalizationAspect has no explicit configuration.

2. VariableSpec.add_item() now supports the three new aspect types
   (QuantityTypeAspect, NormalizationAspect, InverseNormalizationAspect)
   in its select type statement.

Test Results:
- Test_Couplers_suite: 2/2 passing (was 0/2)
- Test_Scenarios_suite: 202/218 passing (was 26/218)
- Remaining 16 failures are in vertical_regridding scenarios and appear
  to be caused by some StateItemSpecs missing the new aspects entirely.
  This requires further investigation.

The update_payload() fix ensures that:
- Mirror aspects always write mirror metadata
- Non-mirror aspects with explicit config write their config
- Non-mirror aspects without explicit config preserve existing metadata
  (which may have been written by QuantityTypeAspect)
- Only overwrites when necessary (mirror mode, explicit config, or existing is mirror)

Related to: Task 2.7 - Update Aspect Ordering for Normalization

author: Tom Clune <thomas.l.clune@nasa.gov>
commit message:
Fix conservative map to use full row representation

The CSR sparse matrix format used by add_row() expects consecutive
columns in each row. The previous implementation incorrectly assumed
it could pass non-consecutive column indices.

Fix: Store full row with zeros for non-overlapping source layers,
then pass all nlev_src values starting from column 1.

Changes:
- Initialize row_weights to all zeros for each destination layer
- Store weight at row_weights(k) for overlapping source layer k
- Call add_row with full row: add_row(matrix, j, 1, row_weights(1:nlev_src))
- Adjust matrix nnz allocation to nlev_dst * nlev_src (full storage)
- Remove unused num_overlaps and row_indices variables

This ensures matmul correctly applies weights from the right source layers.

Fixes test failures where actual values were multiples of expected.

* Phase 1: Add producer/consumer fields and methods to StateItemSpec

* Phase 2: Create StateItemSpec container types

- Moved StateItemSpecPtrVector.F90 from registry/ to specs/ (logical location)
- Updated specs/CMakeLists.txt to include both vector types
- Both containers follow gFTL template pattern
- All 302 tests pass
- No test changes needed (infrastructure only)

* Phase 3a: Add find_closest_spec wrapper method to ExtensionFamily

This is a minimal, safe change that adds a new method find_closest_spec()
which wraps the existing find_closest_extension() method. The new method
returns the StateItemSpec directly instead of the StateItemExtension wrapper.

This allows gradual migration of call sites without breaking existing code.
ExtensionFamily still uses StateItemExtensionPtrVector internally.

* Phase 3b: Add get_primary_spec() and get_extension_spec() wrappers to ExtensionFamily

* Phase 4: Make StateItemExtension producer/consumer methods delegate to spec

StateItemExtension now delegates all producer/consumer operations to its
underlying StateItemSpec. This eliminates the duplication between
StateItemExtension's own producer/consumer fields and those added to
StateItemSpec in Phase 1.

* Phase 5: Remove duplicate producer/consumer fields from StateItemExtension

This commit completes Phase 3-4 of the StateItemExtension refactoring:

Key Changes:
- Added StateItemSpec::make_extension_base() factory method
  * Creates a base for an extension by copying metadata/aspects
  * Does NOT copy producer/consumer chain (key difference)
  * Isolates extension creation logic within StateItemSpec

- Added StateItemSpec::make_extension_with_couplers() factory method
  * Creates extension with transform couplers toward goal_spec

commit message:
Task 2.7: Update aspect ordering for normalization

This commit adds normalization aspects to the coupling order for Field
and FieldBundle classes, ensuring transforms are applied in the correct
sequence for conservative regridding with normalization.

Changes:
- FieldClassAspect: Updated get_aspect_order() to include:
  * QUANTITY_TYPE_ASPECT_ID (after UNGRIDDED_DIMS)
  * NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID (before GEOM_ASPECT for horizontal regrid)
  * INVERSE_NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID (after VERTICAL_GRID for vertical regrid)

- FieldBundleClassAspect: Same aspect ordering updates

New aspect ordering ensures proper transform pipeline:
1. QUANTITY_TYPE_ASPECT_ID - Provides metadata for normalization decisions
2. NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID - Normalize before horizontal regridding
3. GEOM_ASPECT_ID - Horizontal regridding (may be conservative)
4. VERTICAL_GRID_ASPECT_ID - Vertical regridding with fused normalization
5. INVERSE_NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID - Denormalize after vertical regridding
6. UNITS_ASPECT_ID, TYPEKIND_ASPECT_ID - Final conversions

This ordering is required for the complete 3D conservative regridding
workflow introduced in Phase 2 of the conservative regridding plan.

Related: #4478

commit message:
Refactor get_coordinate_field interface to use AspectMap (#4484)

This commit addresses issue #4481 by refactoring the get_coordinate_field()
interface to accept an AspectMap instead of individual scalar parameters
(geom, units, typekind). This makes the interface robust to future changes
when new StateItemAspect subclasses are added.

Key changes:
- Abstract interface now accepts aspects parameter as class(*) to avoid
  circular module dependencies between vertical_grid/ and generic3g/
- Implementations use select type to convert class(*) to AspectMap
- Callee now adds VerticalGridAspect internally to avoid Fortran aliasing
  issues (VerticalGridAspect contains pointer to 'this')
- physical_dimension remains a separate parameter as it's derived information
  computed from comparing source/destination vertical grids
- Call site in VerticalGridAspect::make_transform() updated to build and
  pass AspectMap containing GEOM, TYPEKIND, UNITS, UNGRIDDED_DIMS,
  ATTRIBUTES, and CLASS aspects
- Tests updated to reflect new interface

This eliminates the fragile unpack/repack pattern where callers extracted
individual aspects from an AspectMap, passed them as scalars, and then the
callee had to repack them back into aspects.

commit message:
Add inverse normalization support to NormalizationTransform (Task 2.4)

Extends NormalizationTransform with optional is_inverse parameter to support
both forward normalization (multiply) and inverse normalization (divide).

Changes:
- Add is_inverse boolean member to NormalizationTransform (default false)
- Update constructor to accept optional is_inverse parameter
- Modify update_field() to divide when is_inverse=true (with zero protection)
- Pass is_inverse through update_field_bundle()
- Support both R4 and R8 typekinds
- Add public export of new_NormalizationTransform function
- Remove private attribute from type components (NAG compiler requirement)

Tests:
- test_denormalize_field_R4: Verify inverse with R4 typekind
- test_denormalize_field_R8: Verify inverse with R8 typekind
- test_division_by_zero_R4: Safe handling of zero denominator
- test_roundtrip_R4: Verify normalize→denormalize recovers original

Division by zero handling: When denominator < epsilon, output = 0.0

Note: Aspects still return NullTransform() - coupler infrastructure
needed to create actual transforms (deferred to future tasks).

Implement update_payload() for NormalizationAspect to fix mirror flag propagation

- Implemented update_payload() to serialize aspect state into NormalizationMetadata

- Creates non-mirror NORMALIZE_NONE metadata when aspect has no normalization configured
- Creates non-mirror metadata with parameters when aspect has normalization (DELP/DZ)
- Simplified update_from_payload() to follow UngriddedDimsAspect pattern
- Added roundtrip tests: update_payload -> update_from_payload for mirror and non-mirror cases
- Fixes issue where aspects created with mirror=false in VariableSpec were being overwritten to mirror=true

This fix ensures that default NormalizationAspects created in VariableSpec maintain their
Category 1 (non-mirror) status through the payload serialization/deserialization cycle.

commit message:
Enable 4 additional 4PE distributed mesh tests

This commit enables 4 more multi-PE mesh tests that now pass with the
Phase 3 distributed mesh fixes. The tests verify mesh creation with
different element distributions and mixed element types.

Tests Enabled:
1. test_make_geom_4pe_eight_elements - 8 elements, 2 per PE
   - Tests even distribution with more elements than the basic test
   - Uses 5x3 node grid (15 nodes) with 4x2 element grid (8 quads)

2. test_make_geom_4pe_mixed_elements - Mixed triangles and quads
   - Tests Phase 3 mesh with different element types
   - 1 element per PE with varying node counts

3. test_make_geom_4pe_element_distribution - Verifies decomposition
   - Tests that element distribution indices match expectations
   - Verifies each PE gets correct element range (1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8)

All tests updated with proper synchronization:
- Added ESMF_VMBarrier before ESMF_GeomDestroy
- Added ESMF_VMBarrier after ESMF_GeomDestroy
- Added ESMF_VMBarrier after cleanup_test_file
- Removed global count verification (ESMF_MeshGet returns local counts
  for distributed meshes)

Tests Remaining Disabled:
- test_make_geom_4pe_uneven_distribution: Uneven distribution [3,2,2,1]
  causes ESMF error 509. Requires additional node distribution logic.

- test_make_geom_4pe_from_hconfig: HConfig doesn't properly set up
  decomposition for multi-PE scenarios, causes ESMF error 509.

Test Results:
- Total MeshGeomFactory_File tests: 10 (up from 7)
- 6 single-PE tests: All passing
- 4 multi-PE (4PE) tests: All passing
- 2 tests remain disabled pending further investigation

commit message:
Fix EDGE-staggered field creation in legacy interface

The legacy MAPL_FieldCreate interface with num_levels parameter was
incorrectly assuming CENTER stagger when creating BasicVerticalGrid.
This caused dimension mismatches for EDGE and MIRROR staggered fields.

Changes:
- Add get_num_layers() method to VerticalStaggerLoc to convert field
  dimensions to layer count based on stagger type
- Fix field_create_legacy() to properly convert num_levels to num_layers
  before creating BasicVerticalGrid

For EDGE/MIRROR stagger: num_layers = num_levels - 1
For CENTER stagger: num_layers = num_levels
For NONE stagger: num_layers = 0

This fixes conservative vertical regridding which requires EDGE-staggered
coordinate fields.

commit message:
Task 2.7: Update Aspect Ordering for Normalization (#4480)

* Task 2.7: Update aspect ordering for normalization

This commit adds normalization aspects to the coupling order for Field
and FieldBundle classes, ensuring transforms are applied in the correct
sequence for conservative regridding with normalization.

Changes:
- FieldClassAspect: Updated get_aspect_order() to include:
  * QUANTITY_TYPE_ASPECT_ID (after UNGRIDDED_DIMS)
  * NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID (before GEOM_ASPECT for horizontal regrid)
  * INVERSE_NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID (after VERTICAL_GRID for vertical regrid)

- FieldBundleClassAspect: Same aspect ordering updates

New aspect ordering ensures proper transform pipeline:
1. QUANTITY_TYPE_ASPECT_ID - Provides metadata for normalization decisions
2. NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID - Normalize before horizontal regridding
3. GEOM_ASPECT_ID - Horizontal regridding (may be conservative)
4. VERTICAL_GRID_ASPECT_ID - Vertical regridding with fused normalization
5. INVERSE_NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID - Denormalize after vertical regridding
6. UNITS_ASPECT_ID, TYPEKIND_ASPECT_ID - Final conversions

This ordering is required for the complete 3D conservative regridding
workflow introduced in Phase 2 of the conservative regridding plan.

Related: #4478

* Add default normalization aspects to all fields

- Add QuantityTypeAspect, NormalizationAspect, and InverseNormalizationAspect
  to VariableSpec.make_aspects()
- All three aspects are created in mirror/pass-through mode by default
- This ensures all fields have these aspects in their AspectMap, allowing
  the new aspect ordering to function correctly
- Aspects remain in mirror mode unless explicitly configured for
  conservative regridding with normalization

* Fix: Set mirror=false for default normalization aspects

The new aspects (QuantityType, Normalization, InverseNormalization) should
be Category 1 aspects with sensible defaults, not mirror mode:

- QuantityTypeAspect: QUANTITY_UNKNOWN (generic handling, no special processing)
- NormalizationAspect: No normalization parameters (no transform needed)
- InverseNormalizationAspect: No denormalization (no transform needed)

Setting mirror=false ensures both sides of a connection have explicit
default values, avoiding the double-mirror error (case 2 in can_connect_to).
When both have default values, matches() returns true and no transform is created.

If conservative regridding is later requested with QUANTITY_UNKNOWN, we can
error at that point. Eventually FieldDictionary will provide proper defaults.

* Fix NormalizationAspect matches() for default case

When both src and dst have no normalization configured (aux_field_name not
allocated), they should match - both represent "no normalization needed".

Added check: if neither side has aux_field_name allocated, return true.
This handles the Category 1 default case where all fields get a default
NormalizationAspect with no parameters.

* Fix aspect constructors to use Category 1 defaults (mirror=false)

- Changed NormalizationAspect, InverseNormalizationAspect, and QuantityTypeAspect
  constructors to default to mirror=false instead of mirror=true
- These are Category 1 aspects with sensible defaults that don't require mirror mode
- Updated VariableSpec to remove redundant set_mirror calls (now handled in constructors)
- Fixed NormalizationAspect matches() to handle default case (both unallocated)
- Updated test expectations in Test_NormalizationAspect, Test_InverseNormalizationAspect,
  and Test_QuantityTypeAspect to reflect Category 1 behavior
- Tests now explicitly set mirror=true when testing mirror functionality

This fixes connection failures where both sides had mirror=true (double-mirror invalid)

* Revert constructor changes - keep mirror=true as default

- Reverted NormalizationAspect, QuantityTypeAspect, InverseNormalizationAspect constructors back to mirror=true default
- Kept explicit set_mirror(.false.) calls in VariableSpec.make_aspects()
- Reverted test expectations back to expecting mirror=true by default
- This preserves existing behavior while only changing the new aspects created in VariableSpec

* Add diagnostic test for polymorphic set_mirror - PASSES

This test proves that:
1. set_mirror(.false.) works correctly on class(StateItemAspect) variables
2. Two NormalizationAspects with mirror=false can connect

So the 202 test failures must have a different root cause.

* Implement update_payload() for NormalizationAspect to fix mirror flag propagation

- Implemented update_payload() to serialize aspect state into NormalizationMetadata
- Creates mirror metadata when aspect is mirror=true
- Creates non-mirror NORMALIZE_NONE metadata when aspect has no normalization configured
- Creates non-mirror metadata with parameters when aspect has normalization (DELP/DZ)
- Simplified update_from_payload() to follow UngriddedDimsAspect pattern
- Added roundtrip tests: update_payload -> update_from_payload for mirror and non-mirror cases
- Fixes issue where aspects created with mirror=false in VariableSpec were being overwritten to mirror=true

This fix ensures that default NormalizationAspects created in VariableSpec maintain their
Category 1 (non-mirror) status through the payload serialization/deserialization cycle.

* Fix NormalizationAspect update_payload() to not overwrite QuantityTypeAspect metadata

- Changed update_payload() to only write normalization_metadata when aspect is mirror
  OR has explicit normalization configuration (aux_field_name allocated)
- When non-mirror with no explicit configuration (Category 1 default), leave metadata
  as-is to preserve what QuantityTypeAspect may have written
- This prevents NormalizationAspect from overwriting normalization metadata derived
  from QuantityType with generic NORMALIZE_NONE
- Aspect order: QuantityTypeAspect writes first, NormalizationAspect optionally overrides

* Fix NormalizationAspect serialization to preserve QuantityTypeAspect metadata

This commit fixes two issues related to the new aspect ordering:

1. NormalizationAspect.update_payload() now correctly handles the interaction
   with QuantityTypeAspect by reading existing metadata before deciding whether
   to write. This preserves the normalization metadata derived from quantity
   types when NormalizationAspect has no explicit configuration.

2. VariableSpec.add_item() now supports the three new aspect types
   (QuantityTypeAspect, NormalizationAspect, InverseNormalizationAspect)
   in its select type statement.

Test Results:
- Test_Couplers_suite: 2/2 passing (was 0/2)
- Test_Scenarios_suite: 202/218 passing (was 26/218)
- Remaining 16 failures are in vertical_regridding scenarios and appear
  to be caused by some StateItemSpecs missing the new aspects entirely.
  This requires further investigation.

The update_payload() fix ensures that:
- Mirror aspects always write mirror metadata
- Non-mirror aspects with explicit config write their config
- Non-mirror aspects without explicit config preserve existing metadata
  (which may have been written by QuantityTypeAspect)
- Only overwrites when necessary (mirror mode, explicit config, or existing is mirror)

Related to: Task 2.7 - Update Aspect Ordering for Normalization
Issue: #4478
PR: #4480

* Add new aspects to ModelVerticalGrid coordinate fields

ModelVerticalGrid.get_coordinate_field() manually creates StateItemSpecs
for vertical coordinate fields (PLE, ZLE) but was only adding the old
aspects. This caused vertical_regridding test failures because coordinate
fields were missing QuantityTypeAspect, NormalizationAspect, and
InverseNormalizationAspect.

Add all three new aspects with mirror=false for Category 1 behavior.

Fixes remaining 16 test failures in Test_Scenarios_suite.
All 220 tests now pass (218 scenarios + 2 couplers).

* Fix units allocation in NormalizationAspect.update_from_payload()

Check if units variable is allocated before assignment. When a field/bundle
is created without units set, MAPL_FieldGet/MAPL_FieldBundleGet returns
an unallocated units string. Assigning unallocated to source_units caused
runtime error in tests.

Now defaults to empty string if units not allocated.

Fixes runtime error in test_update_payload_then_from_payload_with_normalization.
All 539 tests now pass.

Add vertical alignment support for coordinate direction handling

This commit implements Tasks 1 and 2 from the vertical alignment feature:
- Add coordinate_direction to VerticalGrid with VerticalCoordinateDirection type
- Add vertical_alignment to VariableSpec and VerticalGridAspect

New Features:
- VerticalCoordinateDirection enum-like type with constants for upward/downward
- VerticalAlignment enum-like type with constants for with_grid/upward/downward

- Default field vertical_alignment is 'with_grid' (follows grid direction)
- Supports shortcuts 'U'/'D' for upward/downward in string constructors
- VerticalAlignment.resolve() method converts alignment to coordinate direction

- Updated VerticalGrid base class and all implementations (BasicVerticalGrid,
  FixedLevelsVerticalGrid, ModelVerticalGrid)

- Updated VerticalGridAspect to use typed VerticalAlignment internally
- Added comprehensive unit tests for both coordinate_direction and vertical_alignment

- All 44 vertical_grid tests pass on GFortran compiler

commit message:
Fixes #344 - refactor MAPL Generic (partially)

Incremental progress

1. Modified interface to MAPL_Get() to use ALLOCATABLE for GEX, GIM,
   GCS, and GCnamelist.  Original interface assumed these are
   contiguous which will not be sustainable under the planned changes.

2. (Re)Introduce fundamental classes in generic subdir.  Made
   MAPL_MetaComp an extension of AbstractComponentNode, and provided
   stub implementations for 3 methods. (Commenting out other
   interfaces in the abstract class for now.)

3. Activate get_parent(), add_child(), and num_children()

4. Introduced MaplComponenNode

   Easier to introduce things in a smaller module.   Replaced String NodeMap with
   an internal map in MaplComponentNdoed wcich uses pointers.   Allows use to
   avoid some SELECT CASE to cast AbstractComponentNodes back to the desired type.

   MAPL_MetaComp now just extends MaplComponentNode.

5. Extracted internal state.

6. Started moving derived types related to import/export specification
   and such.    The goal will be to then refactor into proper classes
   with encapsulation.

7.  Introducing Vector container for array of pointers to VarpSpecType.

    First brute force attempt resulted in run-time issues that were
    difficult to trace.  So going gradually.  Have introduced a
    StateSpecification type that hold the legacy array of pointers and a
    vector and methods that will enable keeping both representations
    consistent.

    New representation is not used yet.

    Various attempts to update use of MAPL_VarSpec based
    upon vectors were failing due to multiple pointer associations
    across objects.

    The basic vector was modified to be MAPL_VarSpec instead of
    MAPL_VarSpecType, and now all works.

    Wrapped new procedure with legacy interface.

    HistoryGridComp uses the older interface in a way that is
    not immediately fixable.

8.  MAPL_GenericGrid
    - Created new module in generic for and renamed to MaplGrid
    - moved component from MAPL_MetaComp to BaseFrameworkComponent

9. Moved 'lgr' component to baseFrameworkComponent.
   - Add obsolete warning to deprecated interface
   - Migrated some grid methods to new class.
   - This necessitated moving some procedures from MAPL_Base into
     MAPL_Generic.

10. Prepping VarSpecMod for relocation.
    - Removed dependencies on MAPL_IO and MAPL_comms.  Used pflogger
      to replicate the functionality.
    - Eliminated dependence of VarSpec on Base.
    - Moved some parameters into new Enumerator module in ./shared.
      MAPL_Base still needs to republish them to avoid issues with external
      codes.

11. Introduced a MaplShared package to export everything from

12. Migrated VarSpec to ./generic.

13. Eliminated use of MAPL_Communicators in MAPL_CFIO.F90.
    - Side benefit - eliminated lots of unused routines and logic associated
      with old and new o-server.

14. Lots of things related to MAPL_Communicators and old O-server
    were eliminated.

15. Kludgy relocation of component logger.

16. MAPL_Initialize is needed in each test layer so pulled
    it over to the pfunit directory.

commit message:
Initialize field values after geometry change in test_propagate_geom

The test checks that changing geometry triggers field reallocation, not
numerical correctness. However, fields created after geom change contain
uninitialized memory from previous tests when running the full suite.

Intel debug mode FPU checking triggers floating invalid exceptions when
TimeInterpolateTransform compares these uninitialized values.

Fix: Initialize field values to 0.0 after MAPL_FieldBundleSet changes
the geometry, ensuring clean memory for subsequent operations.

This fixes the ifx/ifort debug mode test failures in CI.

commit message:
Phase 2 Task 2.1: Implement NormalizationAspect with separated metadata (#4448)

This commit implements Phase 2, Task 2.1 of the conservative regridding implementation:
creating NormalizationAspect as an independent aspect with its own metadata type.

Major refactoring from initial design:
- Split normalization properties from QuantityTypeMetadata into separate NormalizationMetadata
- QuantityTypeAspect derives and writes BOTH metadata types to field/bundle info
- NormalizationAspect reads NormalizationMetadata independently
- Ensures aspects are independent with no direct coupling

New files:
- esmf_utils/NormalizationMetadata.F90: Normalization-specific metadata type
- generic3g/specs/NormalizationAspect.F90: Aspect to handle field normalization
- generic3g/tests/Test_NormalizationAspect.pf: Comprehensive test suite (11 tests)

Modified files:
- esmf_utils/QuantityTypeMetadata.F90: Removed normalization fields
- generic3g/specs/QuantityTypeAspect.F90: Added derive_normalization_metadata()
- field/FieldInfo.F90, FieldGet/Set.F90: Added normalization_metadata parameter
- field_bundle/FieldBundleInfo.F90, FieldBundleGet/Set.F90: Added normalization_metadata
- generic3g/specs/AspectId.F90: Added NORMALIZATION_ASPECT_ID = 10
- generic3g/tests/Test_QuantityTypeAspect.pf: Removed normalization tests (moved to NormalizationAspect)
- generic3g/tests/Test_2DConservativeRegrid.pf: Updated to use NormalizationMetadata

Key architectural decisions:
- NormalizationMetadata constructor requires normalization_type (non-optional) to avoid ambiguity
- Metadata flows: VariableSpec → QuantityTypeAspect → derives both metadata types → writes to field info
- NormalizationAspect and QuantityTypeAspect are completely independent

Builds successfully with NAG compiler. All tests pass.

commit message:
Add integration tests for 3D conservative regridding (Task 2.8)

Create comprehensive integration test file Test_3DConservativeMixingRatio.pf
with 4 real integration tests that perform 3D conservative vertical regridding
and verify mass conservation:

1. test_uniform_field_conservation - Tests with uniform mixing ratio
   (400 ppm), 10→15 layers, verifies exact conservation and uniform output

2. test_realistic_atmospheric_profile - Tests with varying atmospheric
   profile (higher near surface, lower aloft), 72→50 layers with linear
   pressure coordinates

3. test_coarse_to_fine_conservation - Tests resolution increase (5→20
   layers) with varying input data

4. test_fine_to_coarse_conservation - Tests resolution decrease (30→10
   layers) with sinusoidal variation

Each test:
- Creates EDGE-staggered vertical coordinate fields (pressure interfaces)
- Creates CENTER-staggered data fields (mixing ratios at layer centers)
- Sets up VerticalRegridTransform with VERTICAL_REGRID_CONSERVATIVE method
- Uses ESMF States and calls transform->initialize() and transform->update()
- Calculates mass before and after: mass = sum(q × |Δp|)
- Verifies conservation with relative error < 1e-5 (TOLERANCE_LOOSE)
- Uses correct MAPL3 architecture: 2D grids + 3D fields

All tests pass successfully, verifying that:
- The VerticalRegridTransform infrastructure works correctly
- Conservative vertical regridding preserves mass
- Implementation handles various vertical resolution changes
- Both uniform and varying atmospheric profiles are handled correctly

Updated generic3g/tests/CMakeLists.txt to include new test file.

Closes #4497 (Task 2.8)

commit message:
Add vertical alignment support for coordinate direction handling (#4406)

This commit implements Tasks 1 and 2 from the vertical alignment feature:
- Add coordinate_direction to VerticalGrid with VerticalCoordinateDirection type
- Add vertical_alignment to VariableSpec and VerticalGridAspect

New Features:
- VerticalCoordinateDirection enum-like type with constants for upward/downward
- VerticalAlignment enum-like type with constants for with_grid/upward/downward
- Default grid coordinate_direction is 'downward' (GEOS convention)
- Default field vertical_alignment is 'with_grid' (follows grid direction)
- Supports shortcuts 'U'/'D' for upward/downward in string constructors
- VerticalAlignment.resolve() method converts alignment to coordinate direction

Implementation:
- Updated VerticalGrid base class and all implementations (BasicVerticalGrid,
  FixedLevelsVerticalGrid, ModelVerticalGrid)
- Added vertical_alignment field to VariableSpec (user-facing string interface)
- Updated VerticalGridAspect to use typed VerticalAlignment internally
- Added comprehensive unit tests for both coordinate_direction and vertical_alignment

Testing:
- All 44 vertical_grid tests pass on NAG compiler
- All 44 vertical_grid tests pass on GFortran compiler
- New tests verify default values, get/set operations, and string conversions

Related to #4377

Use multistate for add_to_state()

ServiceServices actually add bundles to export states for import
services and vice versa.  Thus, the system cannot use state-intent at
a higher level when filling in gridcomp states.  Instead the full
multistate must be passed down to the item spec's procedure for
`add_to_state()`.  Field can then use same intent and service can
swap.  (And possibly even add something to both import and export.)

Geom.
